articles.summary: GROSSE POINTE FARMS, Mich., July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Saga Communications, Inc. (Nasdaq: SGA) announced today that it will release its 2nd Quarter 2026 Earnings results at 9:00 a.m. EDT on Thursday, August 13, 2026. The company will be holding a conference call on the same date at 11:00
articles.title: Saga Communications, Inc. Announces Date and Time of 2nd Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
